title: Protective effects of Ganoderma lucidum spores on estradiol benzoate-induced TEC apoptosis and compromised double-positive thymocyte development

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: Primary mouse study of an induced thymic-atrophy phenotype explicitly framed as immune aging, reporting completed multi-omics analysis.

causal_design_reviewer.outcome: Thymic epithelial-cell apoptosis, thymic damage, and T-cell/thymocyte development
